description: DevDesk Sandbox Public Probe — Probe a public HTTPS endpoint with GET or POST and return bounded status, timing, selected headers, and a short preview. No vault expansion, inbox, or custom headers. (2 MESH/call, a tool · ops)

body.description: Optional POST body, sent as-is. A GET request cannot include a body — the provider rejects it.

method.description: Optional probe method, GET or POST. Default GET.

url.description: REQUIRED — the public HTTPS endpoint to probe. Private, loopback and link-local hosts are refused by the provider.

name: devdesk-sandbox-public-probe
title: DevDesk Sandbox Public Probe
